$comment: Baby Blue palette by role. Every port (VS Code, Ghostty, Neovim, ...) maps these roles, so dark and white keep the same coloring layout.

roles.bg: Editor and all chrome background (flat, one color)
roles.fg: Default text: variables, functions, types, punctuation
roles.muted: Numbers, constants, operators, attributes, support functions
roles.accent: Keywords and storage (bold), cursor, active tab, highlights
roles.accentFill: Accent used as a fill behind dark text: buttons, remote badge, progress bar
roles.link: Text links, suggest highlight, picker group
roles.frame: Editor group and peek view borders
roles.selection: Selection, hover, current line, find match (translucent)
roles.invalid: Invalid / deprecated tokens (strongest contrast against bg)
roles.surface: Panels, sidebars, popups in TUIs (one step off bg)
roles.surfaceHi: Raised surfaces: active rows, popup selection, statusline sections
roles.pink: Solid version of the selection hue (visual mode, solid fills)
roles.selectionSolid: Selection as an opaque color, for apps that can't do transparency
roles.terminal: 16 ANSI colors 0-15, same as the VS Code integrated terminal. No yellow: slots 3/11 are baby blue.
